[SWS_CORE_12407]
⌊
DRAFT
g
Thread-safety of Explicit Operation Abortion
⌈
While a call to
ara::core::Abort
is in progress, other calls to this function shall
block the calling threads.
⌋
(RS_AP_00130)
ara::core::Abort
provides a means to add a hook into the system, by calling
ara::core::SetAbortHandler
, similar to the way
std::atexit
allows to install
a callback for the
std::exit
mechanism. Unlike
std::atexit
, however, it is only
possible to set exactly
one
handler with
ara::core::SetAbortHandler
.
